wall_climbing_quadruped.description: Four-limbed low-profile robot optimized for climbing or crawling on vertical/rough surfaces.

serpentine_chain.description: Long modular robot with repeated body segments for pipe traversal and confined-space inspection.

aquatic_glider.description: Flattened underwater robot with large fin surfaces and hydrodynamic body.

winged_avian.description: Aerial robot with central fuselage, bilateral wings, and tail stabilizer.

lateral_crustacean_walker.description: Low wide body with side-mounted legs for shoreline or rough lateral traversal.

quadruped_runner.description: Four-legged raised-body robot inspired by mammalian walking/running.

multi_arm_soft_robot.description: Central body with many flexible appendages for manipulation or underwater movement.

armored_low_rover.description: Protected low-profile robot with shell-like protective body.

jumping_amphibian.description: Crouched robot with oversized rear limbs for jumping or burst locomotion.

micro_aerial_insect.description: Lightweight aerial robot with insect-like sensor head, tail boom, and wing-like surfaces.
